ITEM 1 | Grilled fillet piece with crisp, browned, slightly charred skin side showing dark grey-green edge and pale orange-pink flesh with flaky texture, roughly 7 x 5 cm footprint, about 1.5 cm thick, sitting at left-center of plate under garnish | 120
ITEM 2 | Diced pale off-white cubes with lightly golden, slightly crisp edges, firm and matte, roughly 1.5 cm cubes, scattered in a heap at lower right of plate | 90
ITEM 3 | Sliced pale cream-colored strips with fibrous, slightly moist texture and a faint golden tinge at edges, about 6 x 1.5 cm and 0.8 cm thick, lying beside the cubes at right | 60
ITEM 4 | Cubed golden-yellow potato pieces with browned, slightly crisp outer surfaces and soft interior, about 2.5 cm chunks, clustered at upper right of plate | 75
ITEM 5 | Small dark reddish-brown whole olives, glossy and smooth with slight sheen, about 2 cm each, four pieces grouped at top center of plate | 35
ITEM 6 | Thin red bell pepper strips, glossy and moist with slight charring, about 5 cm long, arranged over the fish on left | 20
ITEM 7 | Finely chopped bright green scallion or herb pieces with small pinkish-red thin shreds and sprouts scattered on top of the fish, moist and fresh-looking, a small pile about 4 x 3 cm | 8
ITEM 8 | Scattered loose green salad leaves, small and flat, with pale veins, a few pieces at top left near the fish, slightly wilted | 6
ITEM 9 | Light cream-colored shredded fibrous meat pieces with slightly moist, pulled texture, small pile at upper right beside potatoes | 25
